hts.title: Get started in under 2 minutes
hts.subtitleMobile: Quick step-by-step guide for new players. Support chat is one click away if you get stuck.
hts.subtitleDesktop: A quick step-by-step guide for new players. If you get stuck at any step, the in-app support chat is one click away.
hts.doneText: Need help? The support chat is one click away.

s1.title: Download Minecraft
s1.descMobile: You need Minecraft Java or Bedrock. Java has more plugins.
s1.descDesktop: You need a legal copy of Minecraft (Java or Bedrock edition). The Java edition is what most of our players use because it supports more plugins and custom crafts.
bulletsDesktop: Open minecraft.net and sign in with your Microsoft account.
Download the launcher and install Minecraft 1.20.4 (Java) or the latest Bedrock release.
Launch the game once to verify everything loads.
s1.callout: Cosmetics and tournaments ship to Java first.
s1.calloutDesktop: Both editions work on our servers, but cosmetics and tournament features ship to Java first. Bedrock support arrives 1-2 weeks later.

s2.title: Create your account
s2.descMobile: Sign up with email + password. One-minute activation.
s2.descDesktop: Sign up on our website with your email and password. Activation takes one minute.
bullets: Open Sign Up, enter email + password.
Confirm via the link in your email.
bulletsDesktop: Open the Sign Up page and enter your email + password.
Confirm your email via the link we send (check spam if it does not arrive in 2 min).
Set an in-game nickname — this is what other players will see.

s3.title: Buy or join a server
s3.descMobile: Pick a server, copy the IP, paste in Minecraft.
s3.descDesktop: Pick a server from the Servers page — LuckySurvival, MineWars, or CalmSky. Copy the IP and paste it into Minecraft → Multiplayer → Add Server.
bulletsDesktop: Open the Servers page in your dashboard.
Click “Copy IP” on the card you want.
In Minecraft, choose Multiplayer → Add Server → paste the IP.
Click the server card to connect.
s3.callout: The first join loads the server's custom look — give it a moment to settle in.
s3.calloutDesktop: Your first visit pulls in custom textures and atmosphere — after that, every return is a quick hop back into the world.

s4.title: Link your nickname
s4.descMobile: Connect your in-game name to your account for delivery.
s4.descDesktop: After joining for the first time, link your in-game nickname to your account so privileges and crystals deliver to the right player.
bullets: Check your email for a link.
Click the link to finish linking.
bulletsDesktop: In game, run /link followed by your account email.
We send an activation link to your email.
Open the link in your browser — your nickname is linked automatically.

s5.title: Pick a privilege
s5.descMobile: Unlock cosmetics, cooldowns, and home points.
s5.descDesktop: Privileges unlock cosmetics, faster cooldowns, and extra home points. All eight tiers are listed in the Shop with descriptions and live preview.
bulletsDesktop: Open Shop → Privileges.
Hover any tier to see the full perk list.
Add to cart, pick the server, pay.

s6.title: Top up crystals
s6.descMobile: Buy a pack or use the slider for custom amount.
s6.descDesktop: Crystals are our in-game currency for cosmetics, tournament entries, and time-limited items. Buy a pack or use the custom-amount slider.
bullets: Pick a preset or set amount.
bulletsDesktop: Open Shop → Crystals.
Pick a preset pack or use the slider to set exact amount.
Crystals deliver instantly to your nickname.

s7.title: Follow us on Twitch
s7.descMobile: Streams, tournament highlights, and community hangouts — all on Twitch.
s7.descDesktop: Most of our updates, tournament announcements, and community events happen on Twitch. Free to follow, easy to drop in whenever a stream goes live.
bullets: Turn on notifications for live streams.
bulletsDesktop: Click the Twitch button in the sidebar.
Follow our channel to stay in the loop.
Enable notifications so you never miss a tournament or community stream.
s7.callout: Catch live streams, Q&A sessions, and tournament finals with the rest of the community.
s7.calloutDesktop: Catch live streams, Q&A sessions, and tournament finals with the rest of the community — drop a hello in chat when you tune in.
